summary: Reproduced the Qwen4 loader's retention of superseded Parameters with cyclic GC disabled. The nested PLE shard helper stored its once-per-load warning flag on itself, creating a function/closure cycle that also captured params_dict. Replacing the function attribute with a nonlocal boolean removes the cycle while preserving warning and loading behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: Environment boundary: hiding the ROCm device prevents collection because an imported SGLang module queries device properties at import time. Raw output: reports/j-bf656f4226ca/raw/baseline_qwen4_loader_lifetime.txt

Failing-before regression on the actual Qwen4 loader: both with-PLE and without-PLE lifetime subtests retained the replaced CPU Parameter while cyclic GC was disabled; 3 warning/value tests and 2 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-bf656f4226ca/raw/baseline_qwen4_loader_lifetime_gpu_visible.txt

Passing-after lifetime regression plus independent PLE warning-frequency, repeated-load, matching-dtype, and value-preservation boundaries: 3 tests and 4 subtests passed. The fixture uses CPU tensors; GPU visibility is needed only for module import. Raw output: reports/j-bf656f4226ca/raw/fixed_qwen4_loader_lifetime.txt

Architecture boundary: both NVFP4 Marlin MoE tests skipped on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 because they require NVIDIA SM80/SM86/SM90. Raw output: reports/j-bf656f4226ca/raw/gfx950_marlin_nvfp4_attempt.txt
All applicable touched-file checks passed, including formatting, lint, AST validation, and registered-test CI validation. Raw output: reports/j-bf656f4226ca/raw/precommit.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) was visible, but the defect regression uses CPU tensors and NVIDIA Marlin execution is unsupported; the two selected NVFP4 Marlin tests skipped. No CUDA kernel or full-model GPU result is claimed.

remaining_limitations: The original 2x NVIDIA L20, TP2, 48-layer Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 checkpoint was not available in this job.
The assigned gfx950 GPU cannot execute the NVIDIA Marlin fallback, so persistent CUDA allocation and numerical kernel behavior were not remeasured locally.
The regression validates the real Qwen4 load_weights implementation and Parameter lifetime, not full-model construction, distributed loading, serving, or semantic accuracy.
Original-environment full-checkpoint A/B evidence exists in the upstream issue and PR discussion, but is not presented as execution performed by this job.
